claims.text: Yes, the contract caps liability. Under the Limitation of Liability clause, either party's liability is capped at the amount Corio actually paid for the transaction at issue in the 12 months before the cause of action. The excluded liabilities are those under Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3. The source text is cut off before the end of the sentence.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 2.7, 8, 10 AND 12.3 OF THIS          AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR          RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE          EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE          TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12)          MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE CAUSE OF

claims.text: A second, aggregate cap in the same section limits all claims under the agreement to the total amount Corio paid under the agreement to Changepoint. The same carve-outs (Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3) apply to the exclusion of lost profits and indirect or consequential damages in that section.

citations.quote: IN THE          AGGREGATE, WITH RESPECT OF ALL CLAIMS ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO          THIS AGREEMENT, THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO UNDER THIS          AGREEMENT TO CHANGEPOINT.

EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER          SECTIONS 2.7, 8, 10 AND 12.3 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL          EITHER PARTY HAVE ANY LIABILITY TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY LOST          PROFITS OR COSTS OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES, OR          FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTIAL, SPECIAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

claims.text: A separate clause caps Changepoint's liability at the amounts paid by the customer. Breach of Section 5.2 (unauthorized disclosure of confidential information) and breach of Section 6.4(a) (intellectual property indemnity) are excluded from that cap.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR ANY CLAIM FOR BREACH OF SECTION 5.2 (UNAUTHORIZED DISCLOSURE OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION), OR FOR BREACH OF SECTION 6.4(A) (INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY INDEMNITY), CHANGEPOINT'S ENTIRE LIABILITY, REGARDLESS OF THE FORM OF ACTION, WHETHER BASED ON CONTRACT OR TORT, INCLUDING
(IV) IN THE AGGREGATE WITH RESPECT TO ALL CLAIMS UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT, THE AMOUNT PAID BY CUSTOMER UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

claims.text: Caveat: the sources give different caps and carve-outs. The S1 and S3 caps use the Corio payment base and carve out Sections 2.7, 8, 10 and 12.3. The S7 cap is Changepoint-only and carves out Sections 5.2 and 6.4(a) instead. S5 is a separate end-user clause with a cap equal to the fee the end user paid Changepoint. These sources should be reconciled against the full agreement before relying on any one of them.

citations.quote: CHANGEPOINT'S, LIABILITY UNDER SUCH AGREEMENT FOR DIRECT,       INDIRECT, SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL AND/OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND,       INCLUDING, WITHOUT LIMITATION, RESTITUTION, WILL NOT, IN ANY EVENT, EXCEED       THE FEE PAID BY END USER TO CHANGEPOINT UNDER SUCH AGREEMENT.
